name: Follow Up Sequences
description: Produces post-meeting, post-demo, and post-proposal follow-up email sequences that advance deals through the sales pipeline using sales cadence methodology. Use when the user asks to create follow-up emails after a sales meeting, write post-demo follow-up sequences, build post-proposal nurture emails, or design email sequences that keep deals moving forward. Do NOT use for cold outreach to new prospects (use cold-outreach-sequence), customer onboarding emails (use cs-handoff-document), or marketing email campaigns to subscribers (use email-campaign).
